title: Global stability and sharp decay for the two-dimensional non-rotating primitive equations without thermal diffusion
summary: We study the two-dimensional non-rotating primitive equations with positive horizontal and vertical viscosity and without thermal diffusion. Our main results are fourfold. First, for every integer \(s\ge4\), we prove that sufficiently small, compatible, doubly periodic \(H^s\) perturbations of a stably stratified rest state with an affine temperature profile generate unique global strong solutions; the horizontal velocity and temperature remain uniformly small at the initial Sobolev order despite the derivative loss in the full diagnostic vertical velocity, and strict stratification…
